summary: Woman glissading with a group of seven on Horns Peak triggered a wet slab avalanche in a SE-facing gully at ~12,400 ft; she was carried, partially buried, and seriously injured, then extracted by helicopter and taken to surgery
location: Horns Peak, Sangre de Cristo Mountains (SE gully, ~12,400 ft, 36 deg)
notes: CAIC preliminary report quoted in thread: slide at about 2:45 PM Saturday May 2, 2020; avalanche danger was rated considerable with a special avalanche warning. Victim was an experienced climber, in surgery May 5, 2020 with a good prognosis. News reports listed additional responding agencies (El Paso County SAR, Fremont County SAR, Flight for Life, Colorado Army National Guard) but were not opened this turn.
